long_biography.plain_text:
Alisher Usmanov was born in Chust, Uzbekistan, and trained in international law in Moscow. He says his first fortune came from manufacturing scarce plastic bags during the late Soviet period. After working at Gazprom Investholding, he assembled iron-ore and steel assets through secondary-market acquisitions, consolidating them as Metalloinvest. That company remains his largest holding, making metals and mining the clearest basis of his fortune.

Usmanov later grouped mining, telecommunications, technology and media interests under USM and backed early investments in Facebook and other technology companies. A former competitive fencer, he has also spent much of his later public life in fencing administration and philanthropy supporting culture, education and sport. His portfolio is diversified, but his principal current asset remains Metalloinvest, keeping the underlying wealth story rooted in metals and mining.
